title: BitwrapSnapshotShare
description: "I share this mix": a signed reference to a whole-session snapshot (dj-snapshot.v1) by its CID. The snapshot itself stays unsigned data, served by its CID (cdn.bitwrap.io /ipfs/<cid>/snapshot.json); a verifier fetches it and checks it hashes to the CID named here. The credential's size does not depend on the session's, so it always fits the storage service's blob limit.

id.description: The snapshot: ipfs:// plus the CID of its dj-snapshot.v1 document.

x-rules: the document the id names is a dj-snapshot.v1 DjSnapshot whose CID is that id's

x-credential.standard: W3C Verifiable Credentials Data Model 2.0; this schema constrains credentialSubject
x-credential.cid: CIDv1 dag-json sha2-256, base58btc, multibase z, of the whole credential (proof included)
